State the scope and objective in one paragraph. Name the version
under test and the environment used.

# Test strategy

State the strategy adopted: the levels, the techniques, and the
entry and exit criteria.

# Test results

Summarise the results. Give the counts of passed, failed, and
blocked cases, and the overall verdict.

# Defects

List the defects found. For each, state the severity, the status,
and the case reference.

| ID | Severity | Status | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| T-0001 | High | Open | State the defect. |
| T-0002 | Medium | Fixed | State the defect. |

# Conclusion

State whether the version meets the acceptance criteria. Name any
risks carried into release.
